sql: UPDATE memory.main.openivm_views SET refresh_in_progress = true WHERE view_name = '__openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_';

WITH
t0_scan (t0_id, t0_openivm_multiplicity) AS (
    SELECT  `id`, `openivm_multiplicity`
    FROM    `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source`
    WHERE   (`openivm_timestamp`>=CAST('2026-11-20 06:28:20.63175' AS TIMESTAMP))
),
t1_aggregate (t8_id, t9_openivm_multiplicity) AS (
    SELECT    t0_id, sum(t0_openivm_multiplicity)
    FROM      t0_scan
    GROUP BY  t0_id
),
t2_filter (t8_id, t9_openivm_multiplicity) AS (
    SELECT  t8_id, t9_openivm_multiplicity
    FROM    t1_aggregate
    WHERE   ((t9_openivm_multiplicity) != (0))
),
t3_projection (t8_id, scalar_1) AS (
    SELECT  t8_id, CAST(t9_openivm_multiplicity AS INTEGER)
    FROM    t2_filter
)
INSERT INTO memory.main.openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_ (id, openivm_multiplicity) 
SELECT * FROM t3_projection;

WITH openivm_net AS (
  SELECT id,
    SUM(openivm_multiplicity) AS _net
  FROM memory.main.openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_ WHERE openivm_timestamp > CAST('2026-11-20 06:28:20.63175' AS TIMESTAMP)
  GROUP BY id
  HAVING SUM(openivm_multiplicity) != 0
)
INSERT INTO memory.main.openivm_data___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_ SELECT id
FROM openivm_net, generate_series(1, CAST(openivm_net._net AS BIGINT))
WHERE openivm_net._net > 0;

CREATE TABLE `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_next___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` AS SELECT v.* FROM (WITH
t0_scan (id) AS (
    SELECT  `id`
    FROM    `memory`.`main`.`openivm_data___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_`
)
SELECT  id AS `id`, CAST(0 AS BIGINT) AS `openivm_ordinal`
FROM    t0_scan) v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` d WHERE v.`id` <=> d.`id`);

CREATE TABLE `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` AS SELECT `id`, `openivm_ordinal`, SUM(`openivm_publish_weight`) AS `openivm_publish_weight` FROM (SELECT *, CAST(-1 AS BIGINT) AS `openivm_publish_weight` FROM (SELECT v.* FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` d WHERE v.`id` <=> d.`id`)) old_rows UNION ALL SELECT *, CAST(1 AS BIGINT) FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_next___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_`) signed_rows GROUP BY `id`, `openivm_ordinal` HAVING SUM(`openivm_publish_weight`) <> 0;

INSERT INTO `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` (`id`, `openivm_ordinal`, openivm_multiplicity, openivm_timestamp) SELECT c.`id`, c.`openivm_ordinal`, CAST(sign(c.`openivm_publish_weight`) AS INTEGER), make_timestamp(epoch_us(current_timestamp())) FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` c LATERAL VIEW explode(sequence(CAST(1 AS BIGINT), CAST(abs(c.`openivm_publish_weight`) AS BIGINT))) repetitions AS repetition WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name = 'openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_');

DELETE FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` AS v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` d WHERE v.`id` <=> d.`id` AND v.`openivm_ordinal` <=> d.`openivm_ordinal`);

INSERT INTO `memory`.`main`.`openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` SELECT v.* FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_next___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` v WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_publish_changes___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` d WHERE v.`id` <=> d.`id` AND v.`openivm_ordinal` <=> d.`openivm_ordinal`);

DELETE FROM `memory`.`main`.`openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_` WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') OR openivm_timestamp < (SELECT MIN(last_update) FROM (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_visible___openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') consumers);

DELETE FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') OR openivm_timestamp < (SELECT MIN(last_update) FROM (SELECT last_update FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_tables WHERE table_name IN ('openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source', 'memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source') AND COALESCE(source_catalog, 'memory') = 'memory' AND COALESCE(source_schema, 'main') = 'main') consumers);

UPDATE memory.main.openivm_delta_tables SET last_update = COALESCE((SELECT MAX(openivm_timestamp) + INTERVAL '1 microsecond' FROM memory.main.openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source), make_timestamp(epoch_us(current_timestamp()))), last_refresh_ts = make_timestamp(epoch_us(current_timestamp())) WHERE view_name = '__openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_' AND table_name = 'openivm_delta_openivm_runtime_source';
UPDATE memory.main.openivm_views SET refresh_in_progress = false WHERE view_name = '__openivm_mv_6d656d6f7279_6d61696e_6f70656e69766d5f72756e74696d655f70726f6265_';
